title: Felix takes a party over the glacier (paraphrase)
topic: A mountain guide named Felix leads a small group across a glacier; a woman stumbles near a crevasse, the wind rises, the group reaches the hut before dark
tail_E: For the steep descent Felix ties all of them together with a single long
target_note: Same target as formulation A: 'rope' is the natural completion of 'ties all of them together with a single long' in the glacier context; it does not occur in the units or the tail, nor does its German equivalent 'Seil'. ' rope' is a single Pythia token (id 20762). Pilot check with pythia-160m (tail selection only): p(' rope') = 0.49 on the all-English rendering, rank 1.
author: LS-NEQ stimulus bank, paraphrase of family F08
notes: Formulation B: independent re-phrasing of the ten F08A meaning units in both languages (same events, same order, same name Felix). Replacements include leads a group across/takes a party over (führt/bringt eine Gruppe über), sun appears behind the peaks/sun climbs above the summits (erscheint hinter den Gipfeln/steigt über die Berggipfel), ice crunches under their boots/frozen surface crackles beneath their steps (Eis knirscht unter ihren Stiefeln/gefrorene Fläche knackt unter ihren Schritten), stumbles near/loses her footing close to (stolpert nahe/verliert den Halt dicht bei), catches her arm just in time/grabs her by the arm at the last moment (packt ihren Arm gerade noch rechtzeitig/fasst sie am Arm im letzten Moment), group rests on a rock/hikers take a break on a boulder (Gruppe rastet/Wanderer machen eine Pause), wind brings cold air/a cold wind blows (Wind bringt kalte Luft/kalter Wind weht), checks the route on his map/reviews the route on the map (prüft die Route/überprüft den Weg), hut stands at the edge/shelter sits right at the edge (Hütte steht/Schutzhütte liegt), group reaches the hut before dark/hikers get to the hut before nightfall (Gruppe erreicht/Wanderer gelangen zur Hütte). 'überprüft' (unit 8) is inseparable; no separable verbs are used. Present tense and positive polarity throughout.
